audit.whatIsWrong: The page's central claim about Miasma is wrong in six places. dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t all say 'Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it'; early says it 'grounds you so you can't close the gap'; spikes[0].text says it 'grounds you so you can't walk her down'; wants.foe[1] says 'ground to stop you walking her down'.
audit.why: Grounding disables MOVEMENT ABILITIES. Yorick has none — Riot's description of Mourning Mist is a thrown globule that damages, slows, marks and shreds armour, with no movement on Yorick himself (the kit file's dash flag on E is a tooltip-parsing misfire, independently recorded by the mirror audit). Grounding also never stops you walking. What Miasma actually does to you is slow you and lay a zone your Mist Walkers have to path through, which is the real reason you cannot reach her.
audit.corrected: Every Miasma line now states the slow and the ghoul-zoning, and says plainly that you own no dash for it to ground.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with their own why-text: win[2]/phases[2].side read 'Cassiopeia' while whys[2] and spikes[0].text call level 3 even; win[3] read 'Skill' while whys[3] says she retakes levels 4-5; win[4] read 'Cassiopeia' while whys[4] calls level 6 a skill wash; win[5] read 'Skill' while whys[5] says she favours the first-item spike.
audit.why: The packet levelChart (Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Skill, Cassiopeia, Skill, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia) matches the prose on all four rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-5 aligned to the packet across both layers as one atomic pair-matched group, ratings brought along.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' (sequencingCues 0). Miasma is named as the tracked cooldown in twelve fields and its number appeared in none of them.
audit.why: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 and drops only to 16s at rank 5 — the longest cooldown in her kit by a wide margin, and the entire window in which your ghouls can reach her. Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: The 24s number now appears in dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, spikes[0].text and dosFull[2].d as an explicit 'she spent it, go now' window; spikes[1].text carries R's 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text described Petrifying Gaze as simply stunning you.
audit.why: It stuns only enemies FACING her and slows those with their back turned. That difference is actionable — turning away downgrades a stun into a slow.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now states the facing rule and tells you to turn as it lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal cue anywhere; report[8].t does not even list Executioner's Calling for this matchup.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule 'needs-antiheal': Twin Fang heals Cassiopeia for a percentage of the damage it deals and it is on a 0.75s cooldown, so in any extended trade she is healing continuously off your ghoul chip.
audit.corrected: early now names the Twin Fang heal and tells you to buy Grievous Wounds early.

edits.before: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It slows you and zones your ghouls; you own no dash for it to ground. Engage once it is spent — 24s at rank 1.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — 24s at rank 1; it slows you and walls your ghouls off her, and you own no dash for it to ground. Commit inside those 24s. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Cassiopeia's Miasma: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. When it is down — Cage + ghoul swarm.
edits.after: Track Cassiopeia's Miasma (24s): it slows you and zones the ghouls off her — it does not ground you. When down — Cage + ghoul swarm.

edits.before: Cassiopeia wastes Miasma — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Miasma spent means 24 seconds of ghouls reaching her — go now.

edits.before: Cassiopeia runs levels 1-2 — her Q Noxious Blast and E Twin Fang out-poke your melee kit while W Miasma grounds you so you can't close the gap. Soak XP behind ghouls, block Q with the wave, and don't step onto her Miasma.
edits.after: Cassiopeia runs levels 1-2 — Noxious Blast and Twin Fang out-poke your melee kit, and Twin Fang heals her off every tick of it. Soak XP behind ghouls, buy Grievous Wounds early, and keep the wave between you and her Miasma.

edits.before: Cassiopeia controls the early lane — her Q Noxious Blast poke plus E Twin Fang spam grind you down from range while her W Miasma slows and grounds you so you can't walk her down. Level 3 is even: use ghouls to soak Q and E-mist her when she steps into your minions to farm.
edits.after: Cassiopeia controls the early lane — Noxious Blast (3.5s) and Twin Fang spam grind you from range while Miasma (24s) slows you and cuts your ghouls off from her. Level 3 is even: soak Q with ghouls and Mourning Mist her when she steps into your minions to farm.

edits.before: Cassiopeia spikes at 6 — Petrifying Gaze stuns you if you face her, shutting down any all-in you attempt through your Maiden. Approach only from the side or after she's used W Miasma, and hold Cage for when she commits.
edits.after: Cassiopeia spikes at 6 — Petrifying Gaze (120s) stuns everyone facing her and only slows those turned away, so turn as it lands. Commit after Miasma is spent, and hold Dark Procession for her retreat, not her approach.

edits.before: W Miasma ground to stop you walking her down
edits.after: Miasma to slow you and cut off your ghouls

notes: The grounding claim was the load-bearing error here: six fields told the player that Miasma disables his dashes, and Yorick has no dash to disable. A player reading that has no idea why he actually cannot reach her (the slow plus the zone his ghouls must path through), and will keep walking into it expecting the ground to be the problem. The mirror audit (cassiopeia__yorick) reached the same conclusion from the other side, so the two pages now agree. Also note the packet's other defect — 'Yorick wins 54.23% but the chart gives Cassiopeia 5/7 stages vs 0' — is unresolved: aligning to the packet's own chart keeps it at 5/7 with 2 skill rows. Every Cassiopeia row is backed by prose already on the page, so I did not invent flips. Raised in questionsForUser.
